size_basis: regulation: height 1.125 in | art size unchanged (regular/miniature size per Attachment 7); backing adds 1/8 in each side
citation: OCP: CAPR 39-1 ICL 25-06 para 7.1.1.3.1 (max 4 badges, light silver embroidery on dark blue, 1/8 in of blue exposed at widest/tallest part). ABU: CAPR 39-1 (3 Mar 2020) para 5.1.1.1.2.4 (two aviation/occupational badges, embroidered silver on dark blue, 1/8 in of blue showing) and 5.1.1.1.2.5 (command insignia). Eligible list: Attachment 7 aviation + occupational badges
notes: ABU/OCP version: the finished badge art recoloured to light silver thread on dark blue (colours mapped by luminance), gradients flattened, 1/8 in blue margin. Derived from enamel-buddist-chaplin.

field_uniform.scale_from_backing: art width/height = backing width/height - 0.25 in (1/8 in of blue each side)
